Fresh Food
for Your Crew.

A maritime onboard service designed to improve daily crew life through reliable fresh food, year round.

A Smarter Revolution at Sea

At Agwa, innovation means rethinking how we support life at sea.

At Agwa, innovation means rethinking how we support life at sea.

As a maritime service company, we deliver fresh, chemical free food onboard. It is a smarter way to support crew wellbeing, improve daily routines, and boost performance across global fleets.

Reliable access to fresh food onboard has long challenged the shipping industry.

Agwa provides a fully managed onboard fresh food service that ensures year round availability of premium, chemical free produce. Built for maritime operations, the service adapts to route changes, port restrictions, and harsh sea conditions, delivering a consistent and ongoing supply for crews after the initial setup period.

Plug & Play

Our plug and play onboard service provides crews with easy access to a more varied and reliable fresh

food supply, with no training required. At the core of Agwa’s solution is intelligent automation that manages the entire process seamlessly, removing operational complexity and day to day effort from the vessel.

​

Agwa’s Virtual Agronomist continuously adapts in the background, ensuring consistent performance and fresh food availability regardless of location, route, or sea conditions.
